---
description: "Use when creating or editing authored C# code. Requires XML summary documentation for public methods."
applyTo: "**/*.cs"
---
# C# Public Method Documentation

- Add an XML `/// <summary>` to every public method declaration in authored C# code, including interface members, overrides, extension methods, and overloads.
- Describe the method's purpose or behavior clearly; do not only restate its name.
- When editing an authored C# file, ensure every public method in that file has a summary.
- Do not add annotations to generated C# files.
